label: Theorem 102.1
name: Metric Projection Residual Formula
statement: Transported semilocal orthogonal projection equals A_S-orthogonal projection; R_S=P_A-P has block A_MM^{-1}A_MN.

label: Corollary 102.2
name: Compactness Criterion
statement: R_S is compact/Hilbert-Schmidt iff the off-diagonal metric block P A_S (I-P) is compact/Hilbert-Schmidt, under bounded inverse on M.

label: Proposition 102.3
name: Semilocal Transport Neutrality
statement: Bounded invertible semilocal transport preserves compactness of already compact archimedean residuals; it does not create compactness for raw multiplier defects.

label: Theorem 102.4
name: Delta Compactness Reduction
statement: If archimedean residual is compact-after-quotient and R_S is compact, then Delta_S is compact up to finite-rank pole/null and declared tail terms.

label: No-go 102.5
name: Raw Multiplier Noncompactness
statement: A nonzero multiplication operator on a non-atomic L^2 sector is noncompact; local-factor deformation must enter through paired/projection residual or source absorption.
